description: Estimativa de água disponível do parque estadual da Mata Seca - MG [CNPS] is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Informações de água disponível (AD) no solo são utilizadas fre­quentemente na modelagem de risco agroclimático do Brasil. Essa modelagem é atualizada periodicamente para todo território nacional no contexto do programa de Zoneamento Agrícola de Risco Climático (Zarc). A metodologia utilizada foi a desenvolvida por Araújo Filho et al. (2022). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Minas Gerais, Zoneamento de água no solo, Esquemático, Brasil, CNPS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
